title: Когда работу выполняет специалист
description: Когда работу выполняет специалист: разбираем конструкцию и её смысл на примерах, в диалоге и авторском тексте без аудирования.
objectives: Описывать услуги через have something done
Отличать исполнителя работы от заказчика услуги
notes: Have something done означает организовать выполнение работы другим человеком: I had my laptop repaired.
Время выражается глаголом have, а после объекта стоит причастие: have / had / will have it checked.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: A technician fixed the screen for me. I ___ my screen repaired.
exercises.explanation: Had my screen repaired передаёт заказанную у специалиста услугу.

exercises.prompt: Вставь подходящее слово из пары: inspected / inspect.

public_payload.sentence: We are having the roof ___ by a specialist.

exercises.editorial_answer: We are having the roof inspected by a specialist.
exercises.explanation: После объекта the roof в causative-конструкции требуется причастие inspected.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Перед поездкой я отдам велосипед на обслуживание.»
exercises.editorial_answer: I will have my bicycle serviced before the trip.
exercises.explanation: Will have my bicycle serviced не означает, что говорящий сам выполнит обслуживание.

exercises.prompt: Исправь только ошибку в конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: She had her watch repair at the shop.

accepted: She had her watch repaired at the shop.

exercises.reference_answer: She had her watch repaired at the shop.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She had her watch repair at the shop.
exercises.editorial_answer: She had her watch repaired at the shop.
exercises.explanation: После her watch нужно repaired — причастие результата услуги.

public_payload.passage: Before a long cycling trip, Eva took her bicycle to a repair shop. She had the brakes checked and the chain replaced. The mechanic said that the tyres were still in good condition, so replacing them was unnecessary. Eva had expected a larger bill and appreciated the explanation. She kept the receipt in case a problem appeared during the shop’s warranty period. The visit prepared the bicycle for the journey, although it could not remove every possible risk on the road.

options.label: Eva checked it but kept the old one.
The mechanic replaced the tyres instead.

exercises.explanation: The chain replaced в конструкции had the chain replaced сообщает о замене цепи.

public_payload.passage: Before a long cycling trip, Eva took her bicycle to a repair shop. She had the brakes checked and the chain replaced. The mechanic said that the tyres were still in good condition, so replacing them was unnecessary. Eva had expected a larger bill and appreciated the explanation. She kept the receipt in case a problem appeared during the shop’s warranty period. The visit prepared the bicycle for the journey, although it could not remove every possible risk on the road.

options.label: The shop had lost the receipt.
The warranty prohibited all tyre repairs.
They were still in good condition.

exercises.editorial_answer: They were still in good condition.
exercises.explanation: Механик счёл замену ненужной из-за состояния шин.

exercises.prompt: Уточни, что работу выполнил приглашённый специалист.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Did you paint the kitchen yourself?

options.label: No, I had it painted by a local decorator.
No, I had it paint by a local decorator.
No, I was paint by a local decorator.

exercises.editorial_answer: No, I had it painted by a local decorator.
exercises.explanation: Had it painted by ... обозначает заказанную работу, а не самостоятельное выполнение.

public_payload.sentence: A written promise to deal with certain faults during a set period is a ___.

exercises.explanation: Warranty — гарантийное обязательство с установленными условиями.
